plan.notes: UAS 2026-2027 catalog, B.S. Marine Biology (general path). Catalog states a 120-credit minimum; the published requirement blocks sum to 122 at catalog minimums (GER 36 + ANK 3 + major 46 + marine bio core 10 of 10-12 + bio electives 6 + general electives 21); recorded at the block minimums with total 122, disclosed. A Fisheries Science Emphasis (19-21 cr) may substitute for general electives. 42 upper-division credits required (24 at UAS). No official semester sequence published.

courses.title: General Education Requirements (36 credits)
courses.choice_note: Complete all UAS GERs, which must include BIOL S115 Fundamentals of Biology I, BIOL S116 Fundamentals of Biology II, MATH S251 Calculus I. 36 credits per Marine Biology program page.
